description: This file contains unit tests for the streaming card functionality, specifically testing the behavior of the mergeStreamingText and resolveStreamingCardSendMode functions.

methods.name: mergeStreamingText
methods.description: Merges two pieces of streaming text, preferring the latest full text when available, and appending fragments without introducing newlines.

methods.name: resolveStreamingCardSendMode
methods.description: Determines the sending mode for a streaming card message based on provided context, such as reply-to message ID and root ID.
